response.courseDescription: 473 Pavement Design Pavement performance evaluation, material characterization, traffic analysis, pavement structural response analysis, transfer function application, and pavement design procedures for both flexible and rigid pavements. Cooperative: Open to UI degree-seeking students.
response.coursePrerequisites: CE 317; ECONS 101 or 102; CE 322 or concurrent enrollment; admitted to the major in Civil Engineering.
